---
title: "Publications"
subtitle: "Selected scholarship, academic writing, and collaborative contributions"
page-layout: article
---

::: {.page-card}
# Publications {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Publications bring together microbiology research, educational scholarship, and interdisciplinary collaboration across teaching, mentoring, and scientific practice.
:::

The table below is generated from `works.bib` and supports instant search and column sorting.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.min.js"></script>

<div id="pub-load-status">Loading publications from works.bib...</div>

<figure class="chart-figure" aria-label="Bar chart: publications per year">
	<canvas id="pub-chart" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart showing number of publications per year"></canvas>
	<figcaption id="pub-chart-caption" class="chart-caption"></figcaption>
</figure>

<div id="pub-filters" style="display:none"></div>

<table id="pub-table" class="caption-top table display accessible-table" style="width:100%" aria-label="Publications">
	<caption class="visually-hidden">Publications with year, title, authors, venue, type, and link.</caption>
	<thead>
		<tr>
			<th scope="col">Year</th>
			<th scope="col">Title</th>
			<th scope="col">Authors</th>
			<th scope="col">Venue</th>
			<th scope="col">Type</th>
			<th scope="col">Link</th>
		</tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script>
const drawBarChart = (canvasEl, labels, values, { rotateLabels = false, barColor = null } = {}) => {
	const isDark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
	const primary = isDark ? "#fac800" : "#990000";
	const textColor = isDark ? "#c9c9c9" : "#444444";
	const gridColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";
	const axisColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
	const bar = barColor || primary;
	if (!labels.length || !values.length) {
		const ctx = canvasEl.getContext("2d");
		ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasEl.width, canvasEl.height);
		return;
	}

	const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
	const W = Math.max(canvasEl.parentElement?.clientWidth || 640, 1);
	const compact = W < 520;
	const autoRotate = rotateLabels || (W < 560 && labels.some((lbl) => String(lbl).length > 6));
	const padB = autoRotate ? (compact ? 86 : 72) : (compact ? 58 : 48);
	const H = compact ? 250 : 300;
	const padL = compact ? 40 : 48;
	const padR = compact ? 12 : 16;
	const padT = compact ? 24 : 30;
	const cW = W - padL - padR;
	const cH = H - padT - padB;
	const fontSize = compact ? 10 : 11;

	canvasEl.width = W * dpr;
	canvasEl.height = H * dpr;
	canvasEl.style.width = W + "px";
	canvasEl.style.height = H + "px";

	const ctx = canvasEl.getContext("2d");
	ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
	ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

	const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);
	const niceMax = Math.ceil(maxVal / 5) * 5 || 5;
	const nTicks = 5;

	for (let t = 0; t <= nTicks; t++) {
		const v = (t / nTicks) * niceMax;
		const y = padT + cH - (v / niceMax) * cH;
		ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
		ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, y);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
		ctx.textAlign = "right";
		ctx.fillText(Math.round(v), padL - 6, y + 4);
	}

	const n = labels.length;
	const slot = cW / n;
	const barW = Math.max(slot * 0.65, 4);
	const barOffset = (slot - barW) / 2;

	labels.forEach((lbl, i) => {
		const val = values[i];
		const bH = Math.max((val / niceMax) * cH, 0);
		const x = padL + slot * i + barOffset;
		const y = padT + cH - bH;

		ctx.fillStyle = bar;
		ctx.fillRect(x, y, barW, bH);

		if (val > 0) {
			ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
			ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(val, x + barW / 2, Math.max(y - 5, padT + 12));
		}

		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(x + barW / 2, padT + cH + 10);
		if (autoRotate) {
			ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 4);
			ctx.textAlign = "right";
		} else {
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
		ctx.fillText(lbl, 0, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	});

	ctx.strokeStyle = axisColor;
	ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.moveTo(padL, padT);
	ctx.lineTo(padL, padT + cH);
	ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, padT + cH);
	ctx.stroke();
};

let pubChartRows = [];
let pubResizeTimer;

const renderPubChart = (rows) => {
	const canvas = document.getElementById("pub-chart");
	const caption = document.getElementById("pub-chart-caption");
	if (!canvas) return;
	pubChartRows = rows;

	const yearCounts = {};
	rows.forEach(({ year }) => {
		if (year) yearCounts[year] = (yearCounts[year] || 0) + 1;
	});

	const years = Object.keys(yearCounts).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
	const counts = years.map((y) => yearCounts[y]);

	drawBarChart(canvas, years, counts, { rotateLabels: years.length > 10 });

	if (caption) {
		caption.textContent = `Publications per year: ${years.map((y) => `${y} (${yearCounts[y]})`).join(", ")}.`;
	}
};

if (!window.__pubChartResizeBound) {
	window.__pubChartResizeBound = true;
	window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
		if (!pubChartRows.length) return;
		clearTimeout(pubResizeTimer);
		pubResizeTimer = setTimeout(() => renderPubChart(pubChartRows), 120);
	});
}

const cleanField = (value) => {
	if (!value) return "";
	const asText = String(value)
		.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
		.replace(/[{}]/g, "")
		.replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+\s*/g, "")
		.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
		.trim();

	const decode = document.createElement("textarea");
	decode.innerHTML = asText;
	return decode.value;
};

const parseAuthors = (rawAuthors) => {
	if (!rawAuthors) return "";
	return cleanField(rawAuthors)
		.split(/\s+and\s+/i)
		.map((name) => name.trim())
		.filter(Boolean)
		.join(", ");
};

const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? "")
	.replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
	.replace(/</g, "&lt;")
	.replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
	.replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
	.replace(/'/g, "&#39;");

const sanitizeUrl = (value) => {
	try {
		const parsed = new URL(String(value || ""), window.location.href);
		return parsed.protocol === "http:" || parsed.protocol === "https:" ? parsed.href : "";
	} catch {
		return "";
	}
};

const entryLink = (fields) => {
	const doi = cleanField(fields.doi || fields.DOI);
	const url = cleanField(fields.url || fields.URL);
	if (doi) return sanitizeUrl(`https://doi.org/${doi}`);
	return sanitizeUrl(url);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) => String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
const createDataTable = (selector, options) => {
	try {
		return typeof window.DataTable === "function" ? new window.DataTable(selector, options) : (window.jQuery?.fn?.DataTable ? window.jQuery(selector).DataTable(options) : null);
	} catch {
		return null;
	}
};
const enableBasicColumnSorting = (tableElement, { numericColumns = [], disabledColumns = [], defaultOrder = null } = {}) => {
	const headers = Array.from(tableElement.querySelectorAll("thead th"));
	const tbodyElement = tableElement.querySelector("tbody");
	if (!tbodyElement || headers.length === 0) return;
	const rowsForColumn = (columnIndex) => Array.from(tbodyElement.querySelectorAll("tr")).map((row) => {
		const cell = row.children[columnIndex];
		const raw = (cell?.textContent || "").trim();
		const numeric = Number(raw.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""));
		return { row, raw, normalized: numericColumns.includes(columnIndex) && Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : raw.toLowerCase() };
	});
	const sortByColumn = (columnIndex, direction) => {
		const rows = rowsForColumn(columnIndex);
		rows.sort((a, b) => a.normalized < b.normalized ? (direction === "asc" ? -1 : 1) : a.normalized > b.normalized ? (direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1) : 0);
		tbodyElement.replaceChildren(...rows.map(({ row }) => row));
		headers.forEach((header, index) => {
			header.dataset.sortDir = index === columnIndex ? direction : "";
			header.setAttribute("aria-sort", index === columnIndex ? (direction === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none");
		});
	};
	headers.forEach((header, index) => {
		if (disabledColumns.includes(index)) return;
		header.tabIndex = 0;
		header.style.cursor = "pointer";
		header.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");
		const onSort = () => sortByColumn(index, header.dataset.sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc");
		header.addEventListener("click", onSort);
		header.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
			if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
				event.preventDefault();
				onSort();
			}
		});
	});
	if (defaultOrder) sortByColumn(defaultOrder.column, defaultOrder.direction);
};

const parseBibEntries = (text) => {
	const entries = [];
	const normalized = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
	let index = 0;
	const skipWhitespace = () => { while (index < normalized.length && /\s/.test(normalized[index])) index += 1; };
	const readUntil = (terminator) => { const start = index; while (index < normalized.length && normalized[index] !== terminator) index += 1; return normalized.slice(start, index); };
	const readBalancedBlock = (openChar, closeChar) => { let depth = 1; const start = index; while (index < normalized.length) { const char = normalized[index]; if (char === openChar) depth += 1; if (char === closeChar) depth -= 1; index += 1; if (depth === 0) break; } return normalized.slice(start, index - 1); };
	const parseFields = (body) => {
		const fields = {}; let i = 0;
		const skipFieldWhitespace = () => { while (i < body.length && /\s/.test(body[i])) i += 1; };
		const readFieldValue = () => {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === "{") { i += 1; let depth = 1; const start = i; while (i < body.length) { const char = body[i]; if (char === "{") depth += 1; if (char === "}") depth -= 1; i += 1; if (depth === 0) break; } return body.slice(start, i - 1); }
			if (body[i] === '"') { i += 1; const start = i; while (i < body.length) { if (body[i] === '"' && body[i - 1] !== "\\") break; i += 1; } const value = body.slice(start, i); i += 1; return value; }
			const start = i; while (i < body.length && body[i] !== ",") i += 1; return body.slice(start, i).trim();
		};
		while (i < body.length) {
			skipFieldWhitespace(); if (i >= body.length) break;
			const keyStart = i; while (i < body.length && /[\w\-]/.test(body[i])) i += 1;
			const key = body.slice(keyStart, i).trim(); skipFieldWhitespace(); if (body[i] !== "=") break;
			i += 1; const value = readFieldValue(); if (key) fields[key] = value; skipFieldWhitespace(); if (body[i] === ",") i += 1;
		}
		return fields;
	};
	while (index < normalized.length) {
		const at = normalized.indexOf("@", index); if (at === -1) break; index = at + 1; skipWhitespace();
		const typeStart = index; while (index < normalized.length && /[A-Za-z]/.test(normalized[index])) index += 1;
		const entryType = normalized.slice(typeStart, index).toLowerCase(); skipWhitespace(); if (normalized[index] !== "{") continue; index += 1;
		const key = readUntil(",").trim(); if (normalized[index] === ",") index += 1;
		const body = readBalancedBlock("{", "}"); const entryTags = parseFields(body); entries.push({ entryType, citationKey: key, entryTags, rawEntry: normalized.slice(at, index) });
	}
	return entries;
};

const loadPublications = async () => {
	const status = document.getElementById("pub-load-status");
	const tbody = document.querySelector("#pub-table tbody");
	const filters = document.getElementById("pub-filters");
	const yearLabel = document.createElement("label"); yearLabel.htmlFor = "pub-year-filter"; yearLabel.textContent = "Year: ";
	const yearFilter = document.createElement("select"); yearFilter.id = "pub-year-filter"; yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by year"); yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table"); yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>'; yearLabel.appendChild(yearFilter);
	const typeLabel = document.createElement("label"); typeLabel.htmlFor = "pub-type-filter"; typeLabel.textContent = "Type: ";
	const typeFilter = document.createElement("select"); typeFilter.id = "pub-type-filter"; typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by type"); typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table"); typeFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>'; typeLabel.appendChild(typeFilter);
	const formatLabel = document.createElement("label"); formatLabel.htmlFor = "pub-export-format"; formatLabel.textContent = "Download format: ";
	const formatFilter = document.createElement("select"); formatFilter.id = "pub-export-format"; formatFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Citation download format");
	[["bib", "BibTeX (.bib)"], ["ris", "RIS (.ris)"], ["csv", "CSV (.csv)"]].forEach(([value, label]) => { const option = document.createElement("option"); option.value = value; option.textContent = label; formatFilter.appendChild(option); });
	formatLabel.appendChild(formatFilter);
	const downloadButton = document.createElement("button"); downloadButton.type = "button"; downloadButton.className = "btn btn-primary"; downloadButton.textContent = "Download citations";
	const exportStatus = document.createElement("span"); exportStatus.setAttribute("role", "status"); exportStatus.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
	try {
		const response = await fetch("works.bib");
		if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load works.bib (HTTP ${response.status})`);
		const bibText = await response.text();
		const entries = parseBibEntries(bibText);
		const rows = entries.map((entry) => {
			const fields = entry.entryTags || {};
			return {
				citationKey: entry.citationKey,
				bibtex: entry.rawEntry,
				fields,
				year: cleanField(fields.year || ""),
				title: cleanField(fields.title || ""),
				authors: parseAuthors(fields.author || ""),
				venue: cleanField(fields.journal || fields.booktitle || fields.publisher || ""),
				type: cleanField(entry.entryType || ""),
				link: entryLink(fields)
			};
		});
		rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0));
		renderPubChart(rows);
		[...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.year).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a)).forEach((year) => { const option = document.createElement("option"); option.value = year; option.textContent = year; yearFilter.appendChild(option); });
		[...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.type).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).forEach((type) => { const option = document.createElement("option"); option.value = type; option.textContent = type; typeFilter.appendChild(option); });
		filters.replaceChildren(yearLabel, typeLabel);
		const renderRows = (rowsToRender) => {
			tbody.innerHTML = rowsToRender.map((row) => {
				const escapedTitle = escapeHtml(row.title);
				return `<tr><td data-label="Year">${escapeHtml(row.year)}</td><th scope="row" data-label="Title">${escapedTitle}</th><td data-label="Authors">${escapeHtml(row.authors)}</td><td data-label="Venue">${escapeHtml(row.venue)}</td><td data-label="Type">${escapeHtml(row.type)}</td><td data-label="Link">${row.link ? `<a class="pub-view-link" href="${escapeHtml(row.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View publication: ${escapedTitle}"><span>View</span><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>` : ""}</td></tr>`;
			}).join("");
		};
		renderRows(rows);
		const csvCell = (value) => `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
		const risType = { article: "JOUR", inproceedings: "CONF", conference: "CONF", book: "BOOK", inbook: "CHAP", incollection: "CHAP", phdthesis: "THES", mastersthesis: "THES", techreport: "RPRT" };
		const serializeCitations = (selectedRows, format) => {
			if (format === "bib") return selectedRows.map((row) => row.bibtex).join("\n\n");
			if (format === "ris") return selectedRows.map((row) => {
				const fields = row.fields;
				const lines = [`TY  - ${risType[row.type] || "GEN"}`];
				(fields.author || "").split(/\s+and\s+/i).map(cleanField).filter(Boolean).forEach((author) => lines.push(`AU  - ${author}`));
				[["title", "TI"], ["journal", "JO"], ["booktitle", "T2"], ["year", "PY"], ["volume", "VL"], ["number", "IS"], ["pages", "SP"], ["doi", "DO"], ["url", "UR"], ["publisher", "PB"]].forEach(([field, tag]) => {
					const value = cleanField(fields[field] || fields[field.toUpperCase()] || "");
					if (value) lines.push(`${tag}  - ${value}`);
				});
				lines.push("ER  -");
				return lines.join("\n");
			}).join("\n\n");
			const headers = ["Citation key", "Year", "Type", "Authors", "Title", "Venue", "DOI", "URL"];
			return [headers, ...selectedRows.map((row) => [row.citationKey, row.year, row.type, row.authors, row.title, row.venue, cleanField(row.fields.doi || row.fields.DOI || ""), cleanField(row.fields.url || row.fields.URL || "")])].map((record) => record.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n");
		};
		downloadButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
			const selectedRows = rows.filter((row) => (!yearFilter.value || row.year === yearFilter.value) && (!typeFilter.value || row.type === typeFilter.value));
			if (!selectedRows.length) {
				exportStatus.textContent = "No citations match the selected filters.";
				return;
			}
			const format = formatFilter.value;
			const extension = format === "bib" ? "bib" : format;
			const mimeType = format === "bib" ? "application/x-bibtex" : format === "ris" ? "application/x-research-info-systems" : "text/csv";
			const blob = new Blob([serializeCitations(selectedRows, format)], { type: `${mimeType};charset=utf-8` });
			const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
			const link = document.createElement("a");
			const filterPart = (value) => (value || "all").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "all";
			link.href = objectUrl;
			link.download = `citations-${filterPart(yearFilter.value)}-${filterPart(typeFilter.value)}.${extension}`;
			document.body.appendChild(link);
			link.click();
			link.remove();
			setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 1000);
			exportStatus.textContent = `Downloaded ${selectedRows.length} citations in ${format.toUpperCase()} format.`;
		});
		filters.replaceChildren(yearLabel, typeLabel, formatLabel, downloadButton, exportStatus);
		const table = createDataTable("#pub-table", { pageLength: 25, order: [[0, "desc"]], columnDefs: [{ targets: 0, type: "num", orderable: true }, { targets: [1, 2, 3, 4], orderable: true }, { targets: 5, orderable: false }] });
		if (!table) {
			const applyBasicFilters = () => {
				const yearValue = yearFilter.value;
				const typeValue = typeFilter.value;
				const filteredRows = rows.filter((row) => (!yearValue || row.year === yearValue) && (!typeValue || row.type === typeValue));
				renderRows(filteredRows);
				enableBasicColumnSorting(document.getElementById("pub-table"), { numericColumns: [0], disabledColumns: [5], defaultOrder: { column: 0, direction: "desc" } });
			};
			yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyBasicFilters);
			typeFilter.addEventListener("change", applyBasicFilters);
			enableBasicColumnSorting(document.getElementById("pub-table"), { numericColumns: [0], disabledColumns: [5], defaultOrder: { column: 0, direction: "desc" } });
			filters.style.display = "block";
			status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib. DataTables did not load, so basic column sorting is enabled.`;
			return;
		}
		const applyFilters = () => {
			table.column(0).search(yearFilter.value ? `^${escapeRegex(yearFilter.value)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.column(4).search(typeFilter.value ? `^${escapeRegex(typeFilter.value)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.draw();
		};
		yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		typeFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		filters.style.display = "block";
		status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib.`;
	} catch (error) {
		status.textContent = `Unable to load publications: ${error.message}`;
	}
};

loadPublications();
</script>
